title: Polisar – Ringnaben, Solarflügel und Tankmodule
description: Vergrößerte stehende Ringe sind auf die verlängerte Dockachse zentriert und verstrebt. Links Solarflächen, rechts vier Tanks; kompakte Pads und großer Stationskern bleiben erhalten.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THE USER'S MOST RECENT ANNOTATED POLISAR STATION IMAGE. This is a precise correction of the existing image, not a redesign. The hand-drawn colors are instructions that must disappear from the finished art.
Interpretation of annotations: BLUE horizontal outlines identify the real structural HUB/AXLE, not a scar; RED outlines specify larger upright rings and radial cross-bracing to the hub; GREEN on the left reserves solar arrays; ORANGE at the right specifies FOUR attached fuel tanks.
1. RING GEOMETRY IS THE PRIORITY. Enlarge BOTH existing upright rings, extending them further forward/down into the space map, while retaining the same vertical standing ring planes and narrow edge-on elliptical projection. The continuous horizontal BLUE-MARKED DOCK AXIS at about 43% image height must pass EXACTLY THROUGH THE GEOMETRIC CENTER of EACH ring. The ring centers must move down to this shaft, not remain above it. Each ring should extend approximately equally above and below the shaft in the same orthographic projection: projected top near 7% canvas height, bottom near 79% canvas height, centered at shaft around43%. The rings stay slim standing loops, not circles lying on the map. Construct clear radial spokes / diagonal structural cross-braces connecting the central hub bearing and shaft to the upper and lower ring rim. Use purposeful slender gray metallic trusses with visible connected joints. No unconnected floating arcs. Existing left/right ring planes stay outside the rooms.
2. DOCK AXLE. Lengthen the horizontal structural hub/axle on BOTH sides a little with one or two extra cylindrical/mechanical segments. Move Dock 1 and Dock 2 slightly outward while keeping both outer collars fully visible with comfortable image margin. The left hub, station cross connection and right hub align on ONE straight horizontal axis through the center of both rings. Preserve label 'Dock 1' and 'Dock 2'; substantial sealed docking collars remain at outer ends, with free external approach.
3. LEFT SOLAR WINGS. In the GREEN-marked space around the LEFT extended shaft, add two functional dark-blue photovoltaic wings with fine panel subdivisions and metallic supports: one above the shaft and one below. Attach their hinge/truss roots to the left shaft; do not overlap the ring, docking collar, or access volume. They should occupy the left-side green zone, distinct from existing rear technical decoration. Muted blue surfaces, thin pale frames, practical engineered construction.
4. RIGHT FUEL TANKS. Replace the four ORANGE sketch ovals with FOUR plausible horizontal cylindrical fuel tanks: two above the right shaft, two below it, compact paired arrangement. Light gray tanks with slightly domed ends, retention bands, small ochre safety stripes, visible mounting frames and short pipes linking them to the shaft. They are attached external station modules, not ships, not glowing balls. Keep right docking collar clear of the tank mounting area.
5. PRESERVE THE ACCEPTED CORE. Keep the exact existing central cutaway room layout, blue holographic sphere, larger hub room and shops, people, lighting, and seven compact pads (two M left, one L middle, four S in a2x2 block right), in the same positions and relative scale. Keep the yellow horizontal top map boundary in exactly its current position just behind the front rooms, with rear decorative station dimmed above it and no play-grid above the boundary. Keep black approach space below. Do not move the map boundary down to the front dock shaft: rooms must remain on the playable map. Preserve small ships (light AND medium fighter = one existing hex, utility =two) and the simple approach guide. Preserve high orthographic camera and detailed gray/off-white/ochre industrial Wimmelbild-game styling.
6. CLEANUP. Remove ALL colored freehand blue/red/green/orange annotation strokes from the finished image. Correct the rear building sign from 'POLISA' to 'POLISAR'. Preserve the top title 'POLISAR · STATIONSANFLUG', mini-map '512 × 256' and existing small boundary labels. Repair the warped lower-right hex grid: regular equal-sized coherent six-sided cells everywhere in the playable area, same original grid scale/projection; no stretched cells, broken lines or local perspective bends. Do not make any other stylistic or camera changes. One complete finished 16:9 landscape game-map image.
